seo.title: Donate | Genesis Garden
seo.description: Support Genesis Garden with tax-deductible donations. We accept financial contributions and gently used household goods to help families find stable housing.

hero.heading: Support Our Mission
hero.text: We hope you'll help us do this work! Genesis Garden is an IRS-registered 501(c)(3), so your contributions are tax deductible.

seal.heading: 2026 Candid Silver Seal of Transparency
seal.text: We earned the 2026 Candid Silver Seal of Transparency — demonstrating our commitment to accountability and openness.

financial.heading: Financial Support
financial.intro: We accept monetary donations online and by check payable to Genesis Garden, mailed to:

impactTiers.heading: Eviction Prevention
impactTiers.text: Helps a family stay in their home through financial assistance and support before a crisis becomes a loss.

impactTiers.heading: Emergency Shelter
impactTiers.text: Keeps Genesis House and Leighty House ready for someone who needs a safe place tonight.

impactTiers.heading: Rapid Re-Housing
impactTiers.text: Supports the path from shelter to a stable, permanent home.

goods.heading: Donating Goods
goods.intro: Purchase an item from our wish lists at Amazon or Walmart, or donate gently used household goods and some furniture to help families settle into new homes.
goods.note: We are selective about furniture — please contact us ahead of time.
dontAccept: Clothing or shoes (unless we make a specific request)
